comments.author: Bradybeast13
comments.body_html: Is the no mask version showing as like the clear mask variant or truly nothing? Seems with the mask down in game, the edges of the screen are kind of blurry and such as if you just had the clear mask on.

comments.author: Trinagan
comments.body_html: The no mask is the equivalent of a see-through mask like the Kiver-M face shield, meaning that scratches are present on it, like on the other face masks of this type. The purpose of this is to make it visible to the player that a face mask is equipped and flipped down. The “No Mask” is how the game internally refers to this type of face shield.

comments.body_html: This mod works perfectly, I just hope and pray you add the ability to remove the faceshield filter completely, as OP as it is. Can’t seem to find a mod that does that.

comments.author: Trinagan
comments.body_html:
I have not included this functionality in the mod, as it is already provided by jero’s VisorEffectManager (https://forge.sp-tarkov.com/mod/2429/visoreffectmanager)

I have tested it with my mod and could not find any issues, and there should not be any as afaik their mod changes shader values, whilst mine just overrides either the type of texture selected or scales the existing texture up to appear wider on the screen.
